The '''Tayan League''' was a [[Socialism|socialist]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] party that ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. The League was also focused on the [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] religion.<ref name="Strongholds" />

The Tayan League was formed over 11,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by a group of [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] veterans. It was originally created to fight the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under the [[Pius Dea]]. The League was successful at defeating the forces of the [[Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade]], and took control of Kinyen.<ref name="Strongholds" />

Approximately 1,500 years before the Battle of Yavin, a progressive faction of Tayans formed and took control of the party. They called themselves the [[Neo-Tayan]]s and funded the creation of the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]]. Five hundred years into their leadership, a revolt broke out among the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colony, which ultimately led to the isolation of Kinyen and the loss of its colonies and wealth.<ref name="Strongholds" />
